name: sampler-dff-setup-hold
description: sampler_dff alone at the real 1 Mbps target clock period (design/sampler_core.spice): rising and falling clk-to-Q delay at generous setup margin, plus Q's settling behaviour after a clock-aligned (zero setup AND zero hold) data transition and after 59 ps and 500 ps setup margins, which together bracket the cell's setup time -- the sampler's own setup/hold/metastability characterization DR-0012 leaves to this testbench.
tstep: 100p (print step; ngspice's own LTE sets the actual solver step -- see the testbench header for why 100p, not this repo's usual 1p)
analyses: tran 100p 6.5u
meas tran tclk1 when v(clk)=v(vth) rise=1
meas tran tclk2 when v(clk)=v(vth) rise=2
meas tran tq_r1 when v(q)=v(vth) rise=1
meas tran tq_f1 when v(q)=v(vth) fall=1
meas tran q_rst find v(q) at=0.05u
meas tran q_e1 find v(q) at=0.4u
meas tran q_e2 find v(q) at=1.4u
meas tran q_e3a find v(q) at=2.301u
meas tran q_e3b find v(q) at=2.31u
meas tran q_e3c find v(q) at=2.4u
meas tran q_e4 find v(q) at=3.4u
meas tran q_e5a find v(q) at=4.301u
meas tran q_e5b find v(q) at=4.31u
meas tran q_e5c find v(q) at=4.4u
meas tran q_e6 find v(q) at=5.4u
meas tran q_e7a find v(q) at=6.301u
meas tran q_e7b find v(q) at=6.31u
meas tran q_e7c find v(q) at=6.4u
let vhalf = mean(v(vth))
caveats: Characterizes the SAMPLER CELL only. The entropy source is not present: D is an ideal 1 ps digital transition, not the analog xo swing the cell sees in sampler_core. Nothing here is evidence about jitter, min-entropy, or the raw bitstream -- see sim/tb/sampler-array-digitize/ for the cell driven by the real source.

The setup time is BRACKETED, not measured: this run reports whether the cell captured data arriving 59 ps and 500 ps before the clock edge, which places the setup time inside an interval. It does not sweep the data-to-clock offset, so the interval is as tight as those two points allow and no tighter.

The metastability stress is one aligned edge per run, deterministically placed. That characterizes how this cell RESOLVES when struck at zero margin; it does not estimate a mean-time-between-failures, which needs a statistical treatment of the resolution time constant this deck does not perform.

The clock is ideal: no jitter, no duty-cycle error, no finite source impedance. DR-0012 accepts the external clock's own quality as a system-level dependency this repository does not characterize; this record inherits that limit.
